cohort: Women at more than 22 weeks of gestation who gave birth in Ali ibn Abi Talib Hospital, Zahedan, Iran
finding: A history of C-section was associated with a higher risk of maternal near miss events, and a risk assessment system is needed to diagnose and manage risk factors for severe maternal outcomes during prenatal care.
mod_finding: This study examined maternal near miss indicators and pregnancy outcomes among women with a history of C-section, finding that 58% of near miss cases were related to previous C-sections.
